sql: SELECT start_station_id FROM trip ORDER BY duration LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.date, T1.zip_code FROM weather AS T1 JOIN trip AS T2 ON T1.date = T2.start_date AND T1.zip_code = T2.zip_code WHERE T1.min_dew_point_f < (SELECT MIN(T1.min_dew_point_f) FROM weather AS T1 JOIN trip AS T2 ON T1.date = T2.start_date AND T1.zip_code = T2.zip_code WHERE T2.zip_code = 94107);
SELECT T1.name, COUNT(*) FROM station AS T1 JOIN trip AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.start_station_id GROUP BY T1.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15;
SELECT date FROM weather ORDER BY max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(date), MAX(date) FROM weather;
SELECT T1.name FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flight AS T2 ON T1.aid = T2.aid WHERE T2.flno = 99;
SELECT T1.name, COUNT(*) FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flight AS T2 ON T1.aid = T2.aid GROUP BY T1.name;
SELECT Official_native_language FROM country WHERE Official_native_language ILIKE '%English%';
SELECT Draft_Pick_Number, Draft_Class FROM MATCH_season WHERE POSITION = 'Defender';
SELECT COUNT(*), Player FROM player GROUP BY Player;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT college) FROM country AS t1 JOIN match_season AS t2 ON t1.country = t2.campus WHERE t2.Team = 1;
SELECT POSITION FROM match_season GROUP BY POSITION ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classroom WHERE building <> 'Lamberton';
SELECT T1.salary FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.dept_name = T2.dept_name GROUP BY T2.dept_name, T1.salary ORDER BY AVG(T1.salary) - AVG(T2.budget), T1.salary LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(t1.tot_cred), T2.dept_name FROM student AS t1 JOIN takes AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.course_id JOIN course AS T3 ON t2.course_id = T3.course_id JOIN department AS T2 ON T2.dept_name = T3.dept_name GROUP BY T2.dept_name;

SELECT T1.name, T2.salary FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN advisor AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.i_id JOIN SECTION AS T3 ON T2.s_id = T3.sec_id JOIN course AS T4 ON T3.course_id = T4.course_id JOIN department AS T5 ON T5.dept_name = T4.dept_name WHERE T5.dept_name = 'Math';
SELECT T1.name FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN takes AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.course_id JOIN SECTION AS T3 ON T2.sec_id = T3.sec_id WHERE T3.semester <> 'Spring';
SELECT T1.name FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.dept_name = T2.dept_name WHERE T2.dept_name = 'Comp. Sci.' AND T1.salary > 80000;

SELECT T1.title FROM course AS T1 JOIN SECTION AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id WHERE T2.semester = 'Fall' EXCEPT SELECT T1.title FROM course AS T1 JOIN SECTION AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id WHERE T2.semester = 'Spring';
SELECT T2.Team FROM Elimination AS T1 JOIN wrestler AS T2 ON T1.wrestler_id = T2.wrestler_id GROUP BY T1.wrestler_id, T2.Team HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
SELECT LOCATION FROM wrestler GROUP BY LOCATION HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
SELECT AVG(T1.age), AVG(T1.years_working) FROM journalist AS T1 JOIN news_report AS T2 ON T1.journalist_id = T2.journalist_id GROUP BY T1.journalist_id, T1.name, T1.nationality, T1.years_working;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.student_id) FROM student_course_enrolment AS T1 JOIN courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_tests_taken WHERE test_result = 'Fail';
SELECT T1.login_name FROM students AS T1 JOIN students AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T1.family_name = 'Ward';

SELECT T1.date_of_latest_logon FROM students AS T1 JOIN students AS T2 ON T1.family_name = 'Jaskolski' AND T2.family_name = 'Langosh' UNION SELECT T1.date_of_latest_logon FROM students AS T1 JOIN students AS T2 ON T1.family_name = 'Jankowski' AND T2.family_name = 'Langosh';
SELECT date_of_latest_logon FROM students WHERE family_name = 'Jaskolski' OR family_name = 'Langosh';
SELECT T1.subject_id, T1.subject_name, COUNT(*) FROM subjects AS T1 JOIN courses AS T2 ON T1.subject_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.subject_id, T1.subject_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC;
SELECT T1.course_name FROM courses AS T1 JOIN student_course_enrolment AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_id, T1.course_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.course_name, T1.subject_id FROM courses AS T1 JOIN student_course_enrolment AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_id, T1.course_name, T1.subject_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
SELECT T1.date_test_taken FROM student_tests_taken AS T1 JOIN test_result AS T2 ON T1.registration_id = T2.registration_id WHERE T2.test_result = 'Fail';
SELECT Headquarters FROM company GROUP BY Headquarters ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT District_name, City_Population FROM district WHERE City_Population BETWEEN 200000 AND 2000000;
SELECT T1.product FROM product AS T1 JOIN store_product AS T2 ON T2.Product_ID = T1.product_id WHERE T2.Store_ID IN (SELECT Store_ID FROM store_product WHERE T1.dimensions = '280 x 95 x 40');
SELECT product FROM product WHERE pages_per_minute_color = 5 INTERSECT SELECT product FROM product WHERE dpi = 'A4';

SELECT product FROM product EXCEPT SELECT T1.product FROM product AS T1 JOIN store_product AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.Product_id WHERE T2.max_page_size = (SELECT MAX(max_page_size) FROM store_product);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Ref_Colors;
SELECT product_name, typical_buying_price FROM products;
SELECT T2.color_code, T2.color_description FROM products AS T1 JOIN Ref_colors AS T2 ON T1.color_code = T2.color_code WHERE T1.product_name = 'chervil';
SELECT T2.color_code, T2.color_description FROM products AS T1 JOIN Ref_colors AS T2 ON T1.color_code = T2.color_code WHERE T1.product_name = 'chervil';

SELECT T1.product_id, T2.color_description FROM Product_Characteristics AS T1 JOIN Products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.product_id, T2.product_id, T2.color_description HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products AS t1 JOIN product_characteristics AS t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id JOIN characteristics AS t3 ON t2.characteristic_id = t3.characteristic_id WHERE t1.color_description = 'white' OR t3.characteristic_name = 'hot';
SELECT T2.unit_of_measure FROM Ref_Product_Categories AS T1 JOIN Products AS T2 ON T1.product_category_code = T2.product_category_code WHERE T1.product_category_description = 'Herbs';
SELECT town_city, state_province_county FROM addresses;
SELECT T1.payment_method_code FROM Parties AS T1 JOIN Party_Services AS T2 ON T1.party_id = T2.party_id GROUP BY T1.payment_method_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

SELECT T1.document_type_code, T2.document_name, T2.document_description FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS T2 ON T1.document_id = T2.document_id WHERE T2.document_details = 'Noel CV' OR T2.document_details = 'King Book';
SELECT T1.Project_ID, COUNT(*) FROM Documents AS T1 JOIN Accounts AS T2 ON T1.Statement_ID = T2.Statement_ID WHERE T2.Account_Details = 'Book' GROUP BY T1.Project_ID;
SELECT budget_type_code, budget_type_description FROM Ref_budget_codes;
SELECT T1.Budget_Type_Code, COUNT(*) FROM Ref_Budget_Codes AS T1 JOIN Documents_with_Expenses AS T2 ON T1.Budget_Type_Code = T2.Budget_Type_Code GROUP BY T1.Budget_Type_Code;
